changelog:
- Universal Anti-Adblock Defuser & Scroll Freeze Fix: Defused modals and scroll locks across news sites (The Sun, Fox News, The Guardian, Forbes) with continuous observer and style enforcers.
- High-Contrast Dark Mode: Fixed unreadable dark gray on black text on BBC Sport, Onmanorama, and news sites with high-contrast typography while protecting media.
- Media Player 6-10s Buffering Fix: Integrated Google IMA SDK stub to immediately bypass ad timeouts on JWPlayer, Brightcove, Video.js, Dailymotion, and news video players.
- YouTube Instant Ad Fast-Forward: Fast-forwards video ads at 16x speed (<30ms), auto-clicks skip buttons, neutralizes fake buffering pauses, and bypasses enforcement dialogs.
- NextDNS Live Multi-Layer Blocking: Added NextDNS Ad-Blocking DoH resolver and Private DNS integration with live cross-site query filtering.
